name: Haus Fischbacher
beschreibung: Haus Fischbacher is located in the quiet municipality of Ebbs in the Tiroler Unterinntal, directly at the foot of the Kaisergebirge. The holiday apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, a comfortable bedroom, and a modern bathroom. In the surrounding area, guests will find several dining establishments that offer Tiroler specialties. The Kaiserwinkl region offers a wide range of leisure activities such as hiking, cycling, or skiing in winter at the Zahmer Kaiser. Particularly noteworthy is the quiet and family-friendly atmosphere of the house, which allows for a relaxing holiday. The nearby old town of Kufstein is also easily reachable.
